description: Each AI model's posted API prices in USD per 1M input, cached input and output tokens and its price at the mix of tokens agents send (the models behind the token index and the Intelligence Index chart's, each with its page), with its usage share and its 1-month change. Give a model (name or page id, e.g. "Claude Opus 5.5" or "kimi-k3") for its daily price history as its page's chart draws it (a name several models share, or a family's name such as "Qwen" or "GLM", answers with each one's prices), or a company to list its models. Every other model OpenRouter prices is on the Every AI model page (https://computescreener.com/models): give its name or id (e.g. "meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct"), any company on it (e.g. "Cohere"), or every: true to list them, with sort: "price" for the cheapest input price first. For questions like "what does Claude Sonnet cost per 1M input and output tokens?", "the cheapest AI model API" or "which provider serves a model cheapest" (its name, as the Every AI model page's Cheapest column shows it).

company.description: List only this company's models: one of the token index's companies (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Meta, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, DeepSeek, Z.ai, Xiaomi, StepFun, MiniMax, Mistral, Reflection AI, NVIDIA, Thinking Machines) or any other company on the Every AI model page (e.g. "Cohere", "Amazon").

every.description: List every model on the Every AI model page (/models), not only those with a page.

limit.description: How many models to list (the Every AI model page lists over 300).

model.description: A model's name, a family's name (e.g. "Qwen"), page id or OpenRouter id; omit to list models.

sort.description: "price": the cheapest input price first, then output (every model's default); "name": by company and name. A company's models otherwise come by usage, as its page lists them.

name: get_model_prices

fields.description: What each figure of a model's row is

cache_read_price.description: Posted USD per 1M cached input tokens (the input price where none is posted)

change_1m_pct.description: Change of its price at the mix over 1 month, percent (its page's 1M)

errata.description: Errors found in the final values of its company's index on days the model's prices were wrong. As the page notes them under its value and the status page lists them: each a run of index days. A final value is never changed; the correct one is given when it can be recomputed, and the error is fixed from the next day

correct.description: The correct index value (none when it cannot be recomputed)

index.description: The index whose values were wrong (the model's company)

published.description: The index value as published those days (none when it differs from day to day)

reason.description: Why it was wrong, as the status page says

lowest_provider.description: The cheapest provider serving it (the Every AI model page's Cheapest)

price.description: USD per 1M tokens at the mix (87% cache read, 12% input, 1% output), as the model's own page shows it (models with a page only)

providers.description: Providers serving it (the Every AI model page's Providers)

usage_share.description: Share of the company's tokens among its models in OpenRouter's daily top 50 (0 to 1), the index's weight; null outside the index

total.description: How many models the list has before limit

title: AI model API prices
